scope: Bounded local DMG Game Boy cartridge interpreter with actual LR35902 instruction execution, memory-mapped controller/timer and raster observation. Restricted to explicitly supported cartridge/header profiles.

support.cpu: Official LR35902 base and CB instructions; invalid instructions fail explicitly
cartridges: MBC1 ROM/RAM-bank mode: up to 2 MiB with at most 8 KiB RAM, or up to 512 KiB with 32 KiB SRAM (standard wiring, MBC1M not implemented)
MBC2 0x05/0x06 with up to 256 KiB ROM, built-in 512 × 4-bit battery/nonbattery RAM, A8-qualified register writes and high-nibble readback
MBC5 without rumble (types 0x19–0x1B), up to 8 MiB ROM / 128 KiB SRAM
MBC3 RTC variants 0x0F (timer only) and 0x10 (timer plus SRAM): deterministic emulated CPU-cycle clock, 0->1 latching, 512-day carry, halt and restore
support.ppu: Bounded DMG background/window/sprite raster with approximate timing; not cycle-accurate certification
support.input: Eight DMG controls mapped to declared action set

virtual_rtc.clock: 4,194,304 executed CPU cycles per virtual second

failure: Unsupported mapper/real battery-backed RTC time/rumble or invalid MBC2 built-in RAM geometry, invalid RAM/ROM geometry, malformed header/checksum, illegal opcode, cycle/resource overrun and modified state/ROM identity fail explicitly. No proprietary BIOS, keys or game ROMs are bundled. Standard MBC1 high-ROM and four-RAM-bank wiring cannot coexist.
verification: Experimental source now implements deterministic virtual MBC3 RTC register/edge-latch/rollover state, not wall-clock battery-backed timing. Source tests and manual bus audit are committed but not run. Native hardware timing, RTC standby, boot ROM, CGB-only, rumble, audio and cycle-perfect PPU/APU remain unavailable.
